gizmo.title: Kanema

advanced.title: Yatsani njira yophunzirira
advanced.description: Imazimitsa kupititsa patsogolo ndi kubweza m'mbuyo.

advanced.title: Chotsani batani lotsegula pa YouTube

advanced.title: Mzere wa kufotokoza ndi mawu
